description:
The WBTISEE scheme stands for West Bengal Talent Support for Higher Education. 

It is an initiative by the Government of West Bengal. 

The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to students from economically weaker sections. 

The objective is to support students pursuing higher education in various fields. 

Benefits include scholarships for students enrolled in undergraduate and postgraduate courses. 

The assistance covers tuition fees and other educational expenses. 

Eligibility is primarily based on the economic status of the applicant's family. 

Students must be residents of West Bengal. 

They should have secured admission in recognized institutions for higher education. 

The application process involves filling out an online application form. 

Applicants must provide necessary documents to verify their eligibility. 

The timeline for application submission is typically announced by the state government. 

The scheme is implemented by the West Bengal Higher Education Department. 

Further details can be accessed through the official government website.
